Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
From the text of Create Gargoyle:
"This Gargoyle is the same sect as the acting vampire and is not unique."

To my knowledge, this is the only 'create a new vampire' card that doesn't
default the sect.

Does this mean that if a Tremere "Goes Anarch", and then Creates a Gargoyle,
that it is an Independent Tremere Slave?

And if Pugfar "Goes Anarch", is he still a !Tremere Slave (albeit of the
Independent 'sect')?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
> From the text of Create Gargoyle:
> "This Gargoyle is the same sect as the acting vampire and is not unique."
>
> To my knowledge, this is the only 'create a new vampire' card that doesn't
> default the sect.
>
> Does this mean that if a Tremere "Goes Anarch", and then Creates a Gargoyle,
> that it is an Independent Tremere Slave?

The Gargoyle created is the same sect as the acting vampire, yes.

> And if Pugfar "Goes Anarch", is he still a !Tremere Slave (albeit of the
> Independent 'sect')?

Yes.
